assertions.description: The full boat graph (hull, two thrusters, a declared PWM source, a water body) runs to completion with no solver error.
Each thruster applies exactly the force its declared transfer function gives for the declared duty, to within 1%.
THE HEADLINE: the hull's steady surge speed over the final 30% of the run is within 5% of sqrt(thrust/k) computed from the declared coefficients.
The hull accelerates from rest and its steady-state window has a spread below 2% of the mean.
Speed and actuator signal carry quality 'measured'; nothing about the commanded force is presented as an observation.
Froude number and metacentric height are reported as 'derived' with derivations entries, and the declared planing discontinuity did not fire inside the measured window.
